name: Hotel Garni Elfriede
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Elfriede is located in a quiet alpine setting within the Paznaun Valley in Tyrol's Landeck district. The welcoming family ambiance and pristine mountain surroundings offer wonderful conditions for outdoor activities. Summer presents a rich choice of hiking trails, while winter brings quick access to world-class ski slopes. Amenities include comfortable rooms, a bright breakfast lounge, an on-site sauna area, and private parking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Elfriede in the Paznaun Valley provides peaceful bed-and-breakfast hospitality, a sauna wellness area, and convenient access to premier ski areas around Ischgl.
